title: Kubernetes成为AI基础设施核心，云厂商加速AI代理与基础设施深度融合
core_insight: Kubernetes正从容器编排平台演进为AI基础设施核心，云厂商通过动态资源分配和专用芯片优化大规模AI工作负载部署，同时面临数据中心能耗监管和AI供应链安全挑战

dimension_texts.technology: Kubernetes设备管理迎来重大突破，Google Cloud推出Dynamic Resource Allocation（DRA）技术专门优化GPU/TPU等AI加速器资源调度；AWS推出Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless数据库秒级创建功能；Cloudflare通过RFC 9457标准优化AI代理交互，降低token成本98% Google Data Cloud发布重要更新，llm-d项目成为CNCF沙箱项目；AWS S3引入账户区域命名空间功能；Azure强化PostgreSQL企业级能力，集成Fireworks AI提供高性能开源模型推理 DRA: A new era of Kubernetes device management with Dynamic Resource Allocation Kubernetes as AI Infrastructure: Google Cloud, llm-d, and the CNCF Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds Slashing agent token costs by 98% with RFC 9457-compliant error responses Introducing Fireworks AI on Microsoft Foundry What's new with Google Data Cloud Introducing account regional namespaces for Amazon S3 general purpose buckets A one-line Kubernetes fix that saved 600 hours a year Sandboxing AI agents, 100x faster Introducing OpenClaw on Amazon Lightsail to run your autonomous private AI agents
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Cloudflare推出Custom Regions功能允许精确定义数据存储地理位置，增强数据主权控制；美国参议院要求数据中心报告能耗数据，预示未来监管压力；Google Cloud推出Red Hat OpenShift迁移更新深化混合云战略 Cloudflare发布Gen 13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin 9965处理器，边缘计算性能提升2倍；Google Cloud发布Ironwood TPU训练指南优化万亿参数AI模型算力供应 Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance Introducing Custom Regions for precision data control Data centers get ready — the Senate wants to see your power bills A developer's guide to training with Ironwood TPUs New ways to migrate and scale Red Hat OpenShift on Google Cloud From legacy architecture to Cloudflare One
